# Welcome to Winter Rift 2025 (Season 25 Version):

## INFO:
Map Forcer is not more needed to play this mod!

Project Rey Discord: [Invite](https://discord.gg/pjXSSsmwPF)

## 
Download and conquer the snow in this chilling showcase of Summoner's Rift's winter side!

## About the Mod:

Explore Winter Rift 2025, a frosty transformation of the new 2025 version. Immerse yourself in the icy depths of Summoner's Rift with this custom map skin, featuring a captivating recolor inspired by the cold mysteries of the Rift.

## Changes:

* Snowdown Turrets / Nexus & Inhibitors
* Snowdown Turrets & Minions
